==Background==
"'''UNDERWATER'''" is an original song produced by Hylen featuring Hatsune Miku. It was commissioned for the HATSUNE MIKU Digital Stars 2023 event. This song is mostly made out of sound effects.

==Lyrics==
<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
I'd never sing goodbye words for you.
I wanna see innocence,so true.

On the city lights we were dancing
I'm okay,don't need your care
I wish to be like you How Happy we'd be
Someone tell me why is my heart crying?
</poem>

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured on following albums:
* ''UNDERWATER (single)''
* ''HATSUNE MIKU Digital Stars 2023 Compilation''

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

The Rexium Remix version of this song was featured in the video game {{IW|crypt-of-the-necrodancer|Crypt of the NecroDancer Wiki|Crypt of the NecroDancer}} as DLC.
